settings.title: Round and oval
settings.text: Round diamonds feel classic and bright, while oval diamonds create elongated presence with a softer romantic line.

settings.title: Emerald and cushion
settings.text: Emerald cuts feel architectural and calm; cushion cuts bring a softer antique-inspired brilliance.

settings.title: Pear, marquise, princess, and radiant
settings.text: Distinctive cuts create a more personal silhouette, from directional pear and marquise shapes to crisp princess and radiant sparkle.

settings.heading: Choose the diamond shape that feels like you
settings.subheading: Shape changes the character of a ring: brilliance, finger coverage, proportion, and the emotional mood of the piece.
settings.cta_text: Joyari can help shortlist shapes by hand profile, setting style, and the kind of brilliance you love.
